what: Does the browser page (web/weigh.js) measure a dependency exactly as the CI job does (itemator/weight.py)?
sample: The first 30 weighed lines of results/aidev_weight_v1.json, in file order, each at the version the study weighed. Both sides run one after the other on the same machine, on the same day.
identical_means: the same packages, direct, sized, of, bytes and capped for each line
stop_rules: one run; a difference is reported and explained, never re-run away
a line whose registry answers change between the two runs is reported as such
